description: This file defines type declarations related to the FormData class and associated types, based on an external implementation, for use in TypeScript projects. It provides type annotations for the FormData class, its methods, and related types, facilitating type-safe code when handling form data in a fetch context.

classes.name: FormData
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to construct and manipulate a set of key/value pairs representing form fields and their values, supporting appending, setting, retrieving, and iterating over form data entries.

methods.name: append (name: string, value: unknown, fileName?: string): void append
methods.description: Appends a new value onto an existing key inside a FormData object, or adds the key if it does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a new value for an existing key inside FormData, or adds the key if it does not exist.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the first value associated with a given key, or null if the key does not exist.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all values associated with a given key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists within the FormData object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a key and its associated values from the FormData object.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Executes a callback for each field in the FormData object.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the keys in the FormData.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the values in the FormData.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key/value pairs in the FormData.

methods.name: [Symbol.iterator]
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key/value pairs in the FormData, allowing it to be used in for...of loops.

ctags.name: append
ctags.pattern: /^  append (name: string, value: unknown, fileName?: string): void$/
